words.prose: {{ar:كِتَٰبٍۢ}} ({{tr:kitābin}}) is the grammatical landing point of the oath particle. Its genitive indefiniteness keeps the witness open and magnified: not a named book, but a countable written record whose authority can include document, scripture, ledger, or decree. The noun form also matters for {{ar:ك ت ب}} ({{tr:k-t-b}}): the oath invokes the stable written object, not the act of writing, and it takes up a familiar Quranic noun profile while making that profile indefinite. Within that object, the root's writing, prescribing, and joining pressures converge into a record that is textually fixed and binding, while the following adjective specifies its line-inscribed mode. In the sequence, the witness field moves from the mountain of 52:1 to a textual object, anticipates the medium described in 52:3, and keeps writing active as a same-surah thread at 52:41. Oath-adjacent book contexts at 56:78 and 85:21-22 remain background, but this ayah specializes the field through line-inscription. Its shared genitive-tanwīn cadence with the adjective makes the open oath object sound bound to its qualifier.

words.prose: {{ar:مَّسْطُورٍۢ}} ({{tr:masṭūrin}}) does not add a second witness; it locks onto {{ar:كِتَٰبٍۢ}} ({{tr:kitābin}}) as its agreeing adjective. Its passive participial form presents the record as already inscribed, with the writer left grammatically unspoken and the completed written state foregrounded. The payoff of {{ar:س ط ر}} ({{tr:s-ṭ-r}}) is more specific than generic writtenness: it gives the book ordered line-inscription, a scored arrangement of rows. That choice narrows the root's wider field of tales and control into a positive witness-quality here, while still letting the reader hear the contrast with polemical written-tale language elsewhere. The passive-participle register also appears in record contexts at 17:58, 33:6, and 54:53, and the same surah later touches the root's authority side at 52:37. As the closing word of the ayah, it lands the oath beat on inscription; it also bridges from the named mountain of 52:1 to a described textual record and anticipates the opened medium of 52:3. The matching genitive-tanwīn cadence seals the noun and adjective as one compact oath object.

strongest_changes: The immediate next ayah turns generic inscription into rows exposed on an unfurled writable substrate.
Occurrence and the absence of any repeller turn the binding-book baseline into an executable decree while preserving the alternative that it merely witnesses the event.
Family attachment and individual pledging turn the register into a relational ledger rather than a flat list.
Same-root recurrences at 52:37 and 52:41 activate governance and hidden-source provenance as distinct, coexisting accounts of textual authority.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots do more than name writing: rows migrate into cosmic reference and inhabited order, while later same-root forms expose control and provenance. The packet also supports a contained but unusually coherent manumission activation across contract, bondage, release, and stars.
remaining_uncertainties: The direction between decree and event remains open: operative script, authorized warrant, prediction, and retrospective witness all remain live.
The transfer from the controller form at 52:37 back into the focus participle is branch-backed but morphologically distant.
The social-row and relational-ledger readings may be structural echoes rather than claims about the book's literal contents.
The emancipation and incisional outliers are lexical-material activations and should not be rendered as direct denotations.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi başka bir şeye katarak ikisini bir bütün veya bağlı bir düzen içinde birleştirmektir.

Atların veya askerlerin toplanıp ayrı ve düzenli bir birlik oluşturması, fiziksel birleştirmeden topluluk düzenine uzanan anlamdır.
Kayışın iki yüzünü bir arada tutan boncuk, ortaya çıkan bağın somut bir örneğidir.

İlgili biçimler sözleşmenin kendisini, sözleşmeye bağlı köleleştirilmiş kişiyi ve bağlama göre sözleşmenin öteki tarafını gösterebilir.

Kanıt, tek bir yalın kök imgesinden çok biçime veya özel kullanıma bağlı dağınık adlandırmaları gösterdiği için dal yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan sınırlı bir adlandırma kümesi olarak okunmalıdır.
